WE OFFERS THE FOLLOWING COURSES
Core Courses-
(Consist of one Major and Two Minors)
Major Subjects:
Assamese, Political Science, History, Education, Arabic.
Minor Subjects:
Assamese, English, Political Science, Education, History, Economics, Arabic, Philosophy and Mathematics, Elective-Assamese.
Common Courses-
(Common for all Students)
Multi-disciplinary course (MDC)
- 3 credits
MDN – 101 : Natural Science-1 (For those who belong to the Arts stream in class - XI-XII level)
MDH – 101 : Humanities & Social Science-1 (For those who belong to Science & Commerce stream in class - XI-XII level)
Ability Enhancement course (AEC)
- 2 credits- (A student cannot choose Assamese AEC if he/she has already chosen it in core subjects. He/she has to choose alternative English)
AEC - 101 : Assamese – 1
AEC - 108 : Alternative English -1
Skill Enhancement Course (SEC)
- 3 credits (Among core courses, have to take anyone) – Assamese, English, Education, Political Science, History, Economics, Arabic, Philosophy and Mathematics, Elective-Assamese.
Value Added Course (VAC)
- 2 credits - Group (A) : EVE-101 – Environmental Studies.
Updates
Mission and Objective
Our mission is to create a better world by providing the best education possible. We do this by helping people learn new skills and abilities to help them grow and succeed in their careers, as well as provide them with the knowledge and tools they need to live healthy lives.
We believe that everyone has something to contribute—and we want to help you find your place on this planet.
To strive for quality education in keeping with the motto of the college, “Excellence in Education” and prepare young minds for imbibing knowledge, skills and sensitivity.
